data.title: 墨染希 · 雨停之前慢慢等
data.description: 公交站的屋檐挡住了大半雨水。希把雨衣袖口抖了抖，抱着纸袋挪到长椅里面，为你空出一块干燥的位置。
data.promptProse: Nozomi sits beneath a covered bus stop in a mist-blue raincoat and floral dress, her yellow rain boots resting on the wet pavement. She holds a paper shopping bag against her lap and shifts toward the dry end of the bench, leaving room beside her. Soft gray daylight reflects from the rain.
data.animaCaption: The seat beside her is empty and sheltered under the bus-stop roof.
data.action: 抱着纸袋向里挪，留出干燥的座位
